svg.title: What is the Seeds of Renaissance brand, and how does it play out concretely in design and in the naming of, for example, podcasts?

Like Nate Hagens: one platform, with
one or more stations/series within it.
One podcast on the major platforms (Apple
Podcasts, Spotify), called Seeds of Renaissance.
Stations are distinguished within that single feed
by title prefix and episode type, not by separate
feeds; revisit a separate feed only once a station
Two or more: Over the Mountains for Rufus-led
intellectual interviews; probably one for Temple
of the Sacred World; possibly an extra one,
"Making sense of", like Nate Hagens's Frankly.
How do the website, YouTube playlists,
podcast feed and newsletter relate? Partial
direction: the website is the canonical
releases live on YouTube unless promoted.

YouTube, and switching to our own newsletter.
The switchover itself still needs planning.
